subject: System Design
title: Distributed Transactions
description: A quick win: understand Distributed Transactions.

hook.text: A payment service debits the wallet while an inventory service reserves the item. Both must succeed or both fail.

buildup.text: Distributed transactions span multiple services or databases. Two-phase commit coordinates them.

discovery.text: Phase 1: all participants vote yes or no. Phase 2: if all voted yes, commit. Otherwise, all roll back.

twist.text: If the coordinator crashes between phases, participants are blocked, holding locks indefinitely.

climax.text: Two-phase commit is correct but fragile. Modern systems prefer sagas — a sequence of compensating actions.

punchline.text: Distributed transactions are correct but dangerously fragile.

quiz.question: What happens if the coordinator crashes in two-phase commit?
options: Participants are blocked holding locks indefinitely
